title: Free-transform rotate translates the shape instead of rotating around its pivot
description:
FIXED via direction (a). Root cause: handleFreeTransformRotate (Shell.tsx) updated only {rotation}, ignoring the box-center pivot (originX/originY), while the renderer rotates the shape about its LOCAL origin (obj.x,obj.y) — which is (0,0) for editor-drawn shapes whose geometry bakes absolute coords. So rotation orbited the shape around (0,0) and it drifted across the stage.

Fix: handleFreeTransformRotate now compensates obj.x/obj.y so the pivot stays fixed: newXY = pivot + R(deltaAngle)*(oldXY - pivot), written alongside the new rotation. This makes the handler's pivot agree with the renderer's rotation origin; the bounding-box center is invariant under rotation.

Test (packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/freetransform-rotate-pivot.test.ts, 7 tests, all pass): asserts transformedShapeBounds center is invariant for 30/90/180/270/-45 deg, that successive deltas stay in place (cumulative rotation 90), AND that the naive rotation-only update (the bug) drifts the center by >100px.

VERIFY commands/results:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => Done (all 7 packages, incl authoring-ui type-check of the fix)
- pnpm --filter @flash/core exec vitest run freetransform-rotate-pivot => 7 passed
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 653 passed (44 files)
- pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run => 5302 passed; only 2 tests / 3 files fail, all ENOENT on missing fixtures (flash8-empty.fla / golden) — pre-existing env-missing-fixture failures (task-1207 class), unrelated to this math-only change.
